title: Enrollment Desk Guidance: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Site and Customer Eligibility
content:
A Commercial Natural Gas Supply enrollment is accepted only for a business customer and a site whose premise class is commercial, whose gas utility is not none, whose service state is listed in the plan's eligible states and whose annual therm usage is at least the plan's minimum annual therms and no more than the plan's maximum annual therms. The gas site must be commercial. The enrollment channel must be one of the plan's enrollment channels. Sites above the plan's maximum annual therms are outside the standard commercial gas product.

## Eligibility conditions and the records that show them

| Condition | Where it is shown |
|---|---|
| The customer is a business | Customer type on the customer profile |
| The site's premise class is commercial | Premise class on the premise record of the site being enrolled |
| The site has gas service (gas utility is not none) | Gas utility on the premise record |
| The service state is one of the plan's eligible states | Service state on the premise record, against the plan schedule |
| Annual therm usage is at least the plan's minimum and no more than its maximum | Annual therm usage on the premise record, against the plan schedule |
| The channel is one of the plan's enrollment channels | The channel through which the enrollment is completed, against the plan schedule |

Every condition must hold; an enrollment that fails any one of them is not accepted. The commercial premise class is read from the system record of the premise being enrolled.

## Terms fixed at enrollment

- **Contract rate.** The contract rate per therm is the offer rate of the price offer for the plan and the site's gas utility that is valid on the enrollment date. It is the all-in fixed price on a fixed plan, the locked basis plus adder on a fixed basis plan, and the adder on an index plan.
- **Contracted annual volume.** The contracted annual therms are the site's annual therm usage on the enrollment date.

## Boundary cases on the usage band

| Site's annual therm usage | Meets the usage condition? |
|---|---|
| Exactly the plan's minimum annual therms | Yes |
| One therm below the plan's minimum | No |
| Exactly the plan's maximum annual therms | Yes |
| One therm above the plan's maximum | No; the site is outside the standard commercial gas product |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A dry cleaner enrolls one commercial site served by a gas utility, in an eligible state and within the usage band, on a Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas fixed plan through a broker. The contract rate recorded is the offer rate of the price offer for that fixed plan and that gas utility valid on the enrollment date, which on a fixed plan is the all-in price. The contracted annual therms equal the site's annual therm usage on that date.
